book.name: Yohane
book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: “Nubhaghombela milando ayi ngati nkotoke kuleka kunyubhalila.
Bhandu bhataabhingabhinga mu nyumba hyabhe hya kukonganila, kangi nndaluko ghunguhikaghwene ywohele ywakapala kuakoma katahwacha kukita kangutenda lihehengo lya Chapanga.
Nabho bhatabhatendela milando ayi kiyaha bhangummanya ng'obhe Tate hangi bhangumanya ng'obhe nenga.

Peni nubhaghombela milando ayi, ili palilonda kuhika lisaa lya kutendeka agho, maakulungwa kukita nikibhaghombela.” Mahengo gha Nhuki ywa Chapanga “Nikibhaghombela ng'obhe milando ayi kutandila kalongohi, kiyaha nikibhegha papamu na mwenga.
Peni hinu nenga nungughenda kwa ywombe Ywakanaghilite, na kahone yumu ywenu ywakangonya nungughenda kwoki
Kiyaha nubhaghombela milando ayi, hinu mwenga mungukukulika.
Nungubhaghombela gha hoto, Mbaha kwa mwenga, nenga muke, handa kyangabhuka nenga, aywo Nhuki ywa Chapanga katahika ng'obhe kwa mwenga. Peni pang'enda, ndo ndannaghila kwa mwenga
Naywo paahika kala, kataabhoneha bhandu bha nnima kukita bhanguhokela yakya mihalo ya ulemwa na bhanguhokela yakya ghanakunoghela na bhanguhokela yakya toso ya Chapanga.
Bhanguhokela kwa mihalo ya ulemwa, kiyaha bhangunhyubhalila ng'obhe nenga,
bhanguhokela kwa mihalo ya kunnogheha Chapanga, kya habhu, nungughenda kwa Tate na mwenga mamona ng'obhe kangi,
bhanguhokela kwa mihalo ya toso yanganoghela, kiyaha yula nkulu ywa bhandu bha nnima aghu, ywene ndo Nchipila katoswa kala.”
“Ngali megha na milando miyoloho ya kualubhulila, peni mahotola ng'obhe kuyimanya hinu.

Peni pakapala kuhika aywo Nhuki ywa hoto, kaalongoha ku hoto hyoha ya Chapanga, ywombe kaalongela ng'obhe mihalo yake mwene, ngati katakambuka ghala ghakaghayihwite, na kuaghombela milando yipala kuhika.
Ywombe katabhabhoneha nega mumeghite nkulu, kiyaha kaaghatola ghala ghanighalongela na kuaghombela mwenga.
Hyoha hyakabheghite nahyo Tate ndo hyangu, ndo mana nongela kukita aywo Nhuki katabhaghombela ghala ghoha ghakaghayihwite kuhuma kwa nenga.”
Uhyongololo na uyelelo
“Ghakali manjubha gha mandina ndabhuka na maamona ng'obhe, na mbole ya manjubha gha mandina maamona kangi.”

Apwo amoo ahundwa bhake bhakiyanda kukonyana, “Fwambulo ya agha ghaaghalongela ndo yoki? Kangutughombela kukita yikali manjubha gha mandina maamona ng'obhe, na kangi mbole ya manjubha gha mandina twaammona, kangi kabhegha na mana yoki pakalongela, ‘Kiyaha nugughenda kwa Tate.’
Hino, bhakighendelela kukonyana mana yake ndo yoki paalongela, ‘Yikali manjubha gha mandina?’ Tungumanya ng'obhe Kyakalongela!”

Yesu kakimanya kukita bhakipala kunkonya yakya nnando aghwo, habhu kakiaghombela, “Bhuli, mungukonyana mabhene ya kya ghala ghanighalongilite? Ghakali manjubha gha mandina matamona ng'obhe, na mbole ya manjubha gha mandina matamona kangi.”
Kulyaghila nungaaghombela, mwenga maalila na kukukulika, peni bhandu bha munnima bhatayelelwa, mwenga maabhona machwingo peni uchwingo ghwenu ghwakilibhuka uyelelo.
Yabhegha handa bhula nndala pakaheghelela mu manjubha gha kupapa, peni pakabhelekwa kala mwana kangulibhalila mabhino kubhukana na uyelelo ghwa kubhelekwa mwana munnima.
Na mwenga hinu mmegha na mabhino, peni mbole yake mamona kangi, ndo maayelelwa, na kabhone mundu ywakapala kuabhuhila uyelelo ghwenu.
“Mu linjubha alyo maanyupa ng'obhe kyohele. Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, Tate kataapegha mwenga kyohele kimukiyupa kwa makakala gha lihina lyangu.
Mbaka hinu nnyupa ng'obhe nnando ghwoheli kwa makakala ghangu, kangi nnyupe ili nnyelelwe muno.”
Yesu kaghuhotola nnima
“Nubhaghombela milando ayi kwa mihwano. Lisaa linguhika lyeni ndaalongela ng'obhe na mwenga kwa mihwano, peni ndabhaghombela hotohoto yakya Tate.
Linjubha alyo palihika, maayupa kwa likalama lya lihina lyangu, na ndabhaghombela ng'obhe kukita ndannyupila kwa Tate,
kiyaha Tate mwene kanguapala mwenga. Kanguapala mwenga kiyaha mungumbala nenga na munguhyubhalila kukita huma kwa ywombe.
Nenga huma kwa Tate, na hika apa pannima, na hinu nungubhuka pannima na nungughenda kwa Tate.”
Ndo ahundwa bhake bhakilongela, “Hinu ghungulongela pekupeku kyanga kutumila mihwano.
Muuhiko tungumanya kukita ghwenga ghungumanya milando hyoha, na tubhegha ng'obhe na kihokonyo kwa mundu ywohele kaghukonye. Habhu tunguhyubhalila kukita ghuhuma kwa Chapanga.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Bhuli, hinu munguhyubhalila?

Lisaa linguhika, na kangi lihika kala, pala mabhoha pampala kupwilinganika, na kila yumu ywenu kataghenda mu njila yake, na kuneka ghweka changu. Peni nenga megha ng'obhe ghweka changu, kiyaha Tate kabhegha na nenga.
Nubhaghombela milando ayi ngati mmokole kubhegha na uhihimilo mu kulilunga na nenga. Munnima bhandu bhatabhatenda npamandike, peni muliyonyokehe mwoyo, nenga nughuhotola kala nnima!”
